title: ci(spec): render-projection-diff's base archive lacks the generated `registry.ts` since #22706, so every merge-queue entry fails `Type Check · source gates`
body:
Filing gate: ① a defect with a named site and a reproduction. Reach: the required check `Type Check · source gates` fails on every `merge_group` run whose base is at or after `ed1de8c2db`, so the merge queue is walled for every lane.
Hands-on reader: `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017), which landed the cause (PR #22706, #22554) and claims this card on filing; the os-dev it dispatches makes the fix PR.
Dedupe: the semantic issue search "render-projection-diff base archive missing migration registry Cannot find module" on objectstack-ai/objectstack returned 2 hits (#22554 closed, the cause; #20646 closed, unrelated). Neither carries this defect.

## What fails

- Check `Type Check · source gates`, step "Render the generated spec-changes and upgrade-guide diff against the base" (`.github/workflows/lint.yml:5636`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec tsx scripts/render-projection-diff.ts --base HEAD^1`).
- Error: `Cannot find module '../src/migrations/registry'`, thrown by `build-spec-changes.ts` (`:77`) and `build-upgrade-guide.ts` (`:44`) inside `/tmp/render-projection-diff-*/tree/packages/spec/scripts/`.
- Measured: `merge_group` runs 38092960683 (PR #22735) and 38093887970 (PR #22740). Neither PR touches `packages/spec`. Reported first by `domain:engine` seat 1 on #6017 (`6103300079`).

## Cause (read on `origin/main` `ed1de8c2db`)

- `realMaterializeBase` in `packages/spec/scripts/render-projection-diff.ts` (`:111`–`:133`) unpacks a `git archive` of the base's `packages/spec/src`, `packages/spec/scripts` and two config files, and borrows this checkout's `node_modules`.
- Since PR #22706 (ruling B on #22554), `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` is git-ignored and generated by `gen:migration-registry` from `registry.ts.template` plus `entries/`. A base at or after `ed1de8c2db` therefore archives without it (`git archive origin/main packages/spec/src/migrations | tar -t` lists no `registry.ts`).
- The head side passes because the CI checkout ran install (`prepare`). Main's own push run was green because its `HEAD^1` (`f59a73c395`) still committed the file. PR #22706's own CI was green for the same reason, so this surfaced only after it landed.

## Direction (to be measured by the fix; not a ruling)

- After unpacking, when the base tree lacks `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` and carries its own `packages/spec/scripts/build-migration-registry.ts`, run that generator inside the base tree (it resolves its package root from its own path), before the base's projection generators. A base before #22706 keeps today's path unchanged.
- A pin in `render-projection-diff.test.ts` for a base archive without the registry.
- The fix PR states whether any other `git archive` / base-tree reader of `packages/spec` needs the same step (`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`'s witness layout at `:2089` is the one other archive reader found).

## Acceptance

- `Type Check · source gates` is green on a `merge_group` run whose base is at or after `ed1de8c2db`.
- The walled PRs (#22735, #22740 and any other dequeued entry) can re-queue.
